prompt:
Work from the labeled rectangular tile board in the image. It has 7 rows and 7 columns with visible row and column indices. Each column contains one brown [#887044] tile. If all of them fall straight downward until blocked by a black [#000000] tile or the bottom edge, what is the maximum number of cells any tile moves?
Return a valid JSON object with keys "evidence" and "answer" in that order.
Evidence: set "evidence" to the ordered [row, col] path of the uniquely farthest-falling tile from its start cell to its final cell.
Answer: set "answer" to the maximum downward drop distance in cells as an integer.
Example JSON:
{"evidence":[[0,1],[1,1],[2,1]],"answer":2}
